name: Katyuhen
description: A federated workspace for independent Ivan-VHS products. Shared discovery, versioned contracts and consistent design; no monolithic runtime or implicit privilege sharing.

projects.name: DuckOS / Mora
projects.description: Единая рабочая среда Mora и каталог всего семейства проектов; native OS services остаются отдельными уровнями DuckOS.
projects.scope: Current Mora hub and browser desktop are implemented; native kernel, process broker, compositor and driver services are not represented as shipped.

projects.name: Reaper
projects.description: Язык Reaper, runtime, Studio IDE, LSP/DAP и версионируемый native ABI.
projects.scope: Python reference runtime and Studio tools are implemented; native C17 parity remains partial.

projects.name: OPlague
projects.description: Read-only обнаружение устройств Windows, проверка пакетов драйверов и доказательные отчёты.
projects.scope: Read-only workbench; no driver installation, payload execution or device mutation.

projects.name: Pytyliki
projects.description: C11 workstation для CPU, памяти, профилей, статистики и bounded hardware analysis.
projects.scope: Bounded local inspection and analysis; no host frequency, voltage or scheduler changes.

projects.name: VentuSample
projects.description: C++20/Qt workstation для генерации сэмплов и офлайн-обработки аудио.
projects.scope: Deterministic offline rendering and DSP; optional bridges remain explicit and are not part of the real-time DSP path.

integrations.description: Explicit read-only device snapshot exchange; consumers validate schema, version, limits and provenance.
Optional native interop. Consumer selects the exact trusted library; no implicit discovery.
Reaper audits supported pack-v1 metadata only; it does not open WAV files or score audio quality.
Optional build-time expression runtime from an explicitly selected Reaper checkout; not used in the real-time DSP path.
Optional explicit-library cross-check. VentuSample remains standalone when disabled.
Optional hardware-analysis interoperability; does not add driver write or install operations.

policies: Each project remains independently buildable and useful without its peers.
Mora is the shared desktop identity and discovery surface; it does not imply native process launching or OS privilege.
Mora semantic theme tokens are the canonical visual contract. Native applications may adapt toolkit values locally and must not fetch theme assets at runtime.
JSON exchanges are versioned, size-bounded, validated and provenance-aware. Reject unknown major versions and malformed inputs.
Native libraries are loaded only from an explicit trusted path after ABI and platform checks. Never search PATH or load a manifest-supplied command.
Driver inspection and device mutation are separate. Katyuhen federation does not grant permission to install, load or alter drivers.
Automation must be typed, previewable, auditable and explicitly approved before any consequential action.
Project capabilities and integration maturity must be backed by source, tests and build evidence; a manifest is not proof of runtime availability.
